claims.text: Brainstem levels: CN 1–4 are in the midbrain, CN 5–8 in the pons and CN 9–12 in the medulla.
claims.quote: CN 1-4: midbrain - CN 5-8: pons - CN 9-12: medulla
claims.locator: Cranial nerves section, brainstem levels line

claims.text: I – Olfactory (sensory): smell; loss of smell is anosmia, a reduced sense of smell is hyposmia.
claims.quote: 1 (I) Olfactory - Sensory Nose -Smell: - Anosmia: loss of smell - Hyposmia: ↓sense of smell
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, I Olfactory row

claims.text: II – Optic (sensory): vision, tested with visual acuity, visual fields and the fundoscopic exam.
claims.quote: 2 (II) Optic - Sensory Vision: visual acuity, visual fields, fundoscopic exam
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, II Optic row

claims.text: III – Oculomotor (motor): eye movement through the superior, inferior and medial recti; check for ptosis and PERRLA.
claims.quote: 3 (III) Oculomotor - Motor Eye Mvt: ptosis, PERRLA Periorbital: S./I./Medial Recti Musc
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, III Oculomotor row

claims.text: IV – Trochlear (motor): eye movement through the superior oblique muscle.
claims.quote: 4 (IV) Trochlear - Motor Eye Mvt: EOM, PERRLA S. Oblique Musc
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, IV Trochlear row

claims.text: V – Trigeminal (sensory and motor): opening, clenching and chewing (muscles of mastication), sensation and the corneal reflex; sensory branches are V1 ophthalmic, V2 maxillary and V3 mandibular.
claims.quote: 5 (V) Trigeminal - Sensory & Motor Jaw open/clench/chew + sensory + corneal reflex Sensory Regions: V1: ophthalmic V2: Maxillary V3: mandibular Motor: Somatic efferent to mastication musc
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, V Trigeminal row

claims.text: VI – Abducens (motor): lateral eye movement through the lateral rectus.
claims.quote: 6 (VI) Abducens - Motor Lateral Rectus Muscle Lateral Eye Mvt
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, VI Abducens row

claims.text: VII – Facial (sensory and motor): facial expression and eye and mouth closure; taste to the anterior 2/3 of the tongue; parasympathetic secretion of saliva and tears. Bell's palsy affects both the upper and lower face.
claims.quote: 7 (VII) Facial - Sensory & Motor facial expressions, eye closure, mouth closure + labial sounds Sensory: taste (ant 2/3rds of tongue) Parasympathetic: secretion of saliva & tears - facial weakness: nasolabial folds, lower lid droop - bell's palsy: upper & lower face
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, VII Facial row

claims.text: VIII – Vestibulocochlear (sensory): hearing, and the vestibular sense of head orientation.
claims.quote: 8 (VIII) Vestibulochoclear - Sensory Auditory, Vestibular Head orientation
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, VIII Vestibulocochlear row

claims.text: IX – Glossopharyngeal (sensory and motor): swallowing and taste; sensation to the posterior 1/3 of the tongue, pharynx, middle ear and tonsils; motor to stylopharyngeus, which elevates the pharynx and larynx in swallowing and speech; gag reflex.
claims.quote: 9 (IX) Glossopharyngeal - Sensory & Motor swallowing + taste Sensory: P. 1/3 of tongue; pain, temp, touch -pharynx/middle ear/tonsils Motor: stylopharyngeus musc, elev pharynx/larynx w swallowing/speech, gag reflex
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, IX Glossopharyngeal row

claims.text: X – Vagus (sensory and motor): swallowing, speaking, breathing and phonation; uvula and soft palate; sensation from the pharynx, larynx and external acoustic meatus; gag reflex.
claims.quote: 10 (X) Vagus - Sensory & Motor Swallowing, speaking, breathing, Phonation, uvula, soft palate Sensory: pharynx, larynx, external acoustic meatus Motor: pharynx, soft palate, larynx -swallowing/voice prod (phonation), gag reflex
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, X Vagus row

claims.text: XI – Accessory (motor): sternocleidomastoid and trapezius, for turning the head and shrugging the shoulders.
claims.quote: 11 (XI) Accessory - Motor turn head, shoulder shrug sternocleidomastoid & trap musc
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, XI Accessory row

claims.text: XII – Hypoglossal (motor): intrinsic and extrinsic tongue muscles, for tongue movement and lingual sounds.
claims.quote: 12 (XII) Hypoglossal - Motor tongue mvt, lingual sounds, strength, tremors Intrinsic/extrinsic tongue musc
claims.locator: Cranial nerves table, XII Hypoglossal row
